scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run consumer-web"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.build:consumer: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../consumer-web && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../consumer-web && npm install
